description: This Java class implements encryption and decryption functions using AES encryption in CBC mode with PKCS5Padding. It provides methods to encrypt plaintext strings, decrypt encrypted strings, and handles byte-array to hex-string conversions. The class maintains a secret key and IV as static constants.

classes.name: EncryptionImpl
classes.description: A final class implementing encryption and decryption using AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding, with utility methods to handle byte to hex conversions.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a string value using AES encryption with the provided secret key and static IV. Returns the encrypted data as a hex string.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a hex-encoded string value using AES decryption with the secret key and static IV. Throws an exception if input is blank.

methods.name: bytesToHex
methods.description: Converts a byte array to its hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: hexToBytes
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string to its byte array representation.
